verdicts.proof: productsProvider (shop_provider.dart:12-24, .eq('is_active', true)) is unchanged from 70a94933. Every v2 product surface reads it: shop_screen.dart:23 -> ShopViewV2 products (shop_view_v2.dart:100-117); product_detail_screen.dart:68/75 (shared, above v2 branch :111); upsell_section.dart:29 (booking upsell, same provider). Push 'shop_order' (notification_handler.dart:191-192) and route /shop/:id (router.dart ~459) land on the same screens. Silent in both looks by design.

Old: shop_screen.dart:254-255 (and 70a94933 :231) red 9 px 'soldOut' text, from product.inStock. v2: product_card_v2.dart:56-60 MgTag soldOut (err colors) on the card, semantics label :34. Same Product.inStock; it is the only grid in v2 (shop_view_v2.dart:108-110).

Old: shop_screen.dart:191-208 error branch with retry -> ref.invalidate(productsProvider). v2: shop_view_v2.dart:116 MgErrorView(onRetry) where onRetry = shop_screen.dart:36 ref.invalidate(productsProvider); pull-to-refresh :127 same callback. While in error, no product cards are rendered so nothing can be opened from the grid.
Old: shop_screen.dart:162-174 products.isEmpty -> shopEmpty. v2: shop_view_v2.dart:102-104 list.isEmpty -> MgStateBanner(title shopEmpty, bag icon). Same AsyncValue from shop_screen.dart:23/30.

cartCount computed once at shop_screen.dart:24-25 for both looks. v2: shop_screen.dart:31-33 passes cartCount and onCart=context.push(Routes.cart); shop_view_v2.dart:123 ShopBagButtonV2 -> MgIconButton badge (mg_buttons.dart:328 shows badge only if badge > 0, '9+' above 9 at :341, old showed the full number), semantic label includes count (shop_view_v2.dart:38).

Check is identical: product_detail_screen.dart:41 (needsSize && _selectedSize == null) in shared _addToCart; 70a94933 had the same condition inline in onPressed + toast. The only v2 add entry point is the dock CTA product_view_v2.dart:191-200 -> onAdd = _addToCart (product_detail_screen.dart:125); no other v2 path calls cartProvider.addItem for products (grep: only voucher_screen.dart:54 for vouchers). But in v2 the branch at product_detail_screen.dart:42-44 only sets _sizeHint; the message is an inline warn MgStateBanner under the size chips (product_view_v2.dart:150-155) inside the scrolling body, below a full-width 4:3 photo, name, price, colour/material tiles and a 3-line description. The add button sits in the fixed dock. No toast, no Scrollable.ensureVisible (grep finds ensureVisible only in checkout). On a small phone, with large font, or when the customer scrolled, the banner can be below or above the visible area, so tapping 'Pridat do kosiku' seems to do nothing. The old toast appeared at the top of the screen every time. The banner is a liveRegion for screen readers (mg_state_banner.dart:64). Whether it is actually off-screen on a given phone was not measured.
verdicts.fix_idea: In the v2 branch of _addToCart (product_detail_screen.dart:42-44), in addition to setting _sizeHint, show the same toast as the old look in v2 style (showMgToastRich with title sizeLabel / message selectSizeFirst and a warning icon), or give the size section a GlobalKey and call Scrollable.ensureVisible on it so the warn banner and chips scroll into view.

verdicts.proof: cartId/cartName built from _selectedSize in shared _addToCart (product_detail_screen.dart:49-53), same as 70a94933. v2 onSize sets the same _selectedSize (product_detail_screen.dart:117-120) and onAdd calls the same handler (:125).

Old: product_detail_screen.dart:231-238 soldOut box, :241-283 stepper and add button only if inStock (same in 70a94933). v2: product_view_v2.dart:157-160 err MgStateBanner with ban icon, :161-183 stepper only if inStock, :191-202 dock (the only add entry) is null when !inStock. Shop cards still open the detail page (same as old).

Old: product_detail_screen.dart:247 if (_qty > 1). v2: product_detail_screen.dart:123 onMinus null when _qty <= 1; qty_stepper_v2.dart:22-34 null onTap -> semantics enabled:false and 35 % opacity. Dimmed minus is clearer than the old silent no-op.

No client cap in either look: old product_detail_screen.dart:259 _qty++ (also 70a94933), v2 onPlus product_detail_screen.dart:124 _qty++. Both looks share the cart and checkout logic, so the server-side refusal (create_shop_order) reaches the customer the same way. Not a v2 regression; silent in both.

product_detail_screen.dart:75-87 (product == null -> MgStateScaffold + MgErrorView eoProductGone) runs in build() before _build(), where the v2 branch is at :111, so both looks show the same page. In 70a94933 this was only an AppBar + bare 'error' text, so both looks are now clearer than 4.1.3. Deep link /shop/:id (router.dart ~459) uses the same screen.

product_detail_screen.dart:90-104 loading/error views come before the v2 branch at :111 and are shared by both looks; the add button exists only in _build. 70a94933 had a bare spinner / 'error' text without retry, so the current shared views are clearer than 4.1.3.
